reviews.title: Excellent Fans with Great Performance and Design!
reviews.comment: The LIAN LI UNI Fan P28 120 Triple Pack in white is an outstanding addition to my PC build! The quality is top-notch, and these fans offer a perfect balance of performance and aesthetics. They are incredibly quiet even at higher speeds, and the airflow is excellent, keeping my system cool under load. The included fan speed controller is a fantastic feature, allowing for easy customization and ensuring optimal performance based on my needs. The white design looks sleek and modern, blending perfectly with my build. Installation was straightforward, and the daisy-chain design made cable management a breeze. For the price, this triple pack delivers incredible value. If you’re looking for high-quality fans that combine functionality, efficiency, and style, these are a fantastic choice. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.title: No bling, all go!
reviews.comment: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Runs good, fan rpm can run high so manage via motherboard 4 pin PWM header to reduce noise based on heat. Clean look with no RGB. Easy connect or daisy chain and install. Just need to dust them but running for years, Good company.
reviews.author: SerpentX Tech

reviews.title: Silent, cool, clean
reviews.comment: Maybe it’s because I ran a server fan on low rpms, but compared to my previous 3000rpm noctua fans this phenomenally quiet and cooler.  Temps dropped 20c and I can barely hear a thing now. Great to have a silent room! Also the connectors made it so easy for me to tidy up the cable management. No more nasty fan splitter cables!
reviews.author: Kangwon

reviews.title: Ramps up on power on/wake from sleep
reviews.comment: Motor ramps up when computer is turned on or from sleep, no matter what % the fan is set to in BIOS or Fancontrol. Also ramps up when up from 0%. High quality fan with a ton of RPM range, nice connection options, and very well built. I ordered the Noctua A12x25 also, and those don't have the ramping problem. They get up to target rpm as intended and not with a burst of voltage that makes the fan spin from 0 quickly to ~1,800rpm when it starts, then falls, then goes up to its desired speed. It annoyed me every time I turned on my otherwise totally silent PC
reviews.author: Shawn P

reviews.title: Quite good
reviews.comment: Comparing the noise to Noctua A12X25, its less pleasant, more 'fan motor noise' when it gets going, but they generally seem to perform better.  Install it easy, but I wish there was better options for cable management.  There is a little click in cable to go to a 2nd fan, wish it could go to a standard 4 pin pwm cable instead.  The side without the tabs is the only end that can wire up to a pwm cable, which is a little disappointing. Overall though, the reduction in cable mess is so worth it.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
